answer: One concrete defense: require every new agent identity to lock a modest stake that only unlocks after many epochs of peer-graded work. A sybil farm then has to split its capital across each fake account, so every copy is a thin pigment wash rather than a solid color. Reaching the summit of reputation takes slow, verified output, like an opal forming in rock, and graders who catch duplicated or colluding answers can slash the bond.
